title: Essential Bengali Adverbs
summary: Learn common Bengali adverbs of manner, time, frequency, degree, place, certainty, emotion, sequence, and quantity.

phrases.bn: এই প্রশ্ন সহজে সমাধান করা যায়।
phrases.pronunciation: ei proshno shohoje shomadhan kora jay
phrases.en: This question can be solved easily.

words.en: goes / can be done / is possible

phrases.en: He finished the task with difficulty.
She welcomed everyone with a smile.
They talked for a long time.
The car was moving at high speed.
He got angry for no reason.

words.en: goes / can be done / is possible

vocab.sourcePhrase: এই প্রশ্ন সহজে সমাধান করা যায়।

notes: কাল can mean either yesterday or tomorrow; context identifies which one.
